message: 仲良きことは

name: Woman
message: 「Hello, Nanaka-san」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Hello, Nanaka-san」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, Fuyuka-san. Hello」
Fuyuka-san?

name: Nanaka
message: 「Fuyuka Anenokouji-san. She's the representative for Chocolat l'Or」
Speaking of Chocolat, they're one of the cake shops that graciously set up a stall at our cake buffet. No wonder she looked familiar.

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Sakura-san, the Student Council President. Thank you very much for reaching out to us for the Ryuusei Kira-Kira Festival」
How does she know my name? Is this the power of being Student Council President too?
Nanaka lightly nudged me with her elbow and whispered.

name: Nanaka
message: 「You met face-to-face several times during the planning meetings, didn't you」

name: Synn
message: 「...Excuse me. Likewise, thank you very much for your cooperation at KiraFes」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello. Thank you very much for your cooperation at KiraFes」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「There is no need for you to thank me」
True to someone in customer service. I guess she never neglects a sponsor.

name: Fuyuka
message: 「In particular, Nanaka-san took wonderful care of me, so I am the one who ought to be offering thanks」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-It's really nothing worthy of being thanked so formally like that」

name: Synn
message: 「Did something happen with Nanaka?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「She taught me anew the true depth of sweets」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No way... I just, well... ate them, that's all...」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「You are too modest. Besides, just as you said, flavor is everything when it comes to sweets--nothing begins unless you taste them」

name: Synn
message: 「That's actually a pretty nice saying」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-You too, Synn, what are you saying... Back then, I acted all cocky in a bunch of ways... It's embarrassing just remembering it」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「I am embarrassed about what happened back then as well, so we are even」
I don't really know what happened, but judging by the vibe between the two of them, it doesn't seem like anything bad.

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Nanaka-san. Please do come visit the shop again」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You don't even have to ask, I'd love to.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Please let me treat you every once in a while.」
Fuyuka-san glanced over at me

name: Fuyuka
message: 「When that time comes, bring your boyfriend along.」
